title: Pika Pika no Mi (Glint-Glint Fruit)
facts: Logia, light; Yasakani no Magatama; Ama no Murakumo light sword; lasers; Rayleigh blocked Kizaru at Sabaody; Kizaru vs Straw Hats at Sabaody

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird star-topped yellow#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird star-topped yellow fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Logia#orange that turns your whole body into light.#gold
lines.say: a Logia that turns your whole body into light.

lines.text: First, you move at the speed#blue of light,#gold zipping anywhere in a flash.
lines.say: First, you move at the speed of light, zipping anywhere in a flash.

lines.text: Then you fire lasers#red from your fingers that blow up#orange anything they hit.
lines.say: Then you fire lasers from your fingers that blow up anything they hit.

lines.text: You can even make a sword#blue out of pure light.#gold
lines.say: You can even make a sword out of pure light.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue attack is Yasakani no Magatama:#gold a rain of light bullets.
lines.say: Your strongest attack is Yasakani no Magatama: a rain of light bullets.

lines.text: Haki#red users can still hit you, and Rayleigh#blue blocked Kizaru's kick with just a sword.
lines.say: Haki users can still hit you, and Rayleigh blocked Kizaru's kick with just a sword.

lines.text: Admiral Kizaru#gold uses it, and he beat the Straw Hats#red at Sabaody before Kuma sent them away.
lines.say: Admiral Kizaru uses it, and he beat the Straw Hats at Sabaody before Kuma sent them away.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never need a flashlight.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit never need a flashlight.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
